entry_points_note: The plugin has two doors: the skill fires on natural language, the command fires when the model reaches for /overture directly. Either counts as triggering — both route to the same place — so the eval must accept both or it reports false negatives.
note: Should-trigger cases deliberately avoid naming the skill, the command, or the word 'proposal' where a real user wouldn't. Should-not-trigger cases are near-misses: they share vocabulary (decide, status, descope, publish, plan, align, Confluence) but need something else. Cases that are obviously irrelevant test nothing.

cases.query: I need to get design and eng aligned on reviving our invitations flow before I write anything up. Where do I start?

file a ticket for the bug where invitation emails render the wrong org name in the subject line, and assign it to me

help me plan out the next sprint — I've got 6 tickets and two people out, what should we pull in
find me the confluence page that documents our oncall rotation, I can never remember the escalation order
here's the transcript from the accounts sync this morning, can you summarize it into notes I can paste into slack
what's the status of the deploy to staging, did the migration finish
descope PROJ-4412 down to just the email template change, the rest can wait for next quarter
publish the draft blog post about our auth migration to the engineering blog, it's in content/posts/auth-migration.mdx
review the diff on my branch and tell me if the invitation expiry logic handles the timezone edge case correctly
